subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline image rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or only render trusted structured media/media-store references from current tool result details?
rationale: The feature is useful, but this branch crosses from model/tool text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current structured image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Permit this path-read shape only with an explicit trusted-root policy, focused tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical tracker
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57592 as the feature tracker while closing or parking this stale draft until a maintainer sponsors the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current structured image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent image_generate feature and core TUI/media product boundary make steipete the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
